title: The Haptic Editor Guide (ORIGINAL)
description: I've had a lot of people ask me how to make haptics. And since I am in a really good mood right now, I thought it might be fun to help instruct you all in how to do so. Fortunately some lovely minions of mine were also willing to help me along in this endeavour. In particular, thanks to Ilori, there is now a fantastic little tool that makes creating them super super easy ... So come join me for Haptics Class! And if you enjoyed this video or found it informative, please do consider checking out all the links below. I can't wait to see what creations you all come up with! TimestampsYou can find timestamps listed below for each of the main sections in the audio along with a brief descriptive label. Hopefully this will then allow you to quickly jump back to a specific section to recall information or find a keyboard shortcut as needed. &nbsp-- : 00:00:00 : Haptic Creation Intro & Credits &nbsp-- : 00:00:50 : Download Instructions 1.0 : 00:01:46 : The "HapticEditor.exe" Guide 1.1 : 00:01:56 : Loading Audio | Supported Audio Types & Conversion 1.2 : 00:02:32 : Loading Audio | Waveform Display 2.0 : 00:03:25 : Creating Haptics | Placing A Point 2.1 : 00:03:38 : Creating Haptics | Removing A Point (Shortcut: [Alt]) 2.2 : 00:03:54 : Creating Haptics | Scripting Modes & Snapping (Shortcut: [F1]) 2.3 : 00:04:16 : Creating Haptics | Patterns (Shortcut: [Q]) 2.4 : 00:05:07 : Creating Haptics | Free Mode 2.5 : 00:05:32 : Creating Haptics | Playback Speed (Shortcuts: [S],[W],[R]) 3.0 : 00:05:49 : Saving Your Funscript | (Shortcut: [Ctrl + S]) &nbsp-- : 00:05:57 : Haptic Creation Outro & Links Links[Introducing Hypnotic Haptics: The Rise of the Machines]This article, written by one of the leading developers of haptic technology, is a useful primer on the world of scripted vibrations, and is well worth a read. Yall can also be contacted on the Haptic Fun site, where they maintain a javascript web library for haptic support and offer custom commissions for those wanting haptics for their very own audios. They also have a fun little Patternator you can enjoy playing around in, to get a sense of what they feel like.[Ilori's Haptic Editor]This is the direct link to Ilori's github page for his haptic creation tool, which you can freely download. For more info on how to use their tool, (along with the github help documentation), check out this accompanying instruction manual they have provided as well. (Thanks to my minions working together behind the scenes, you can now also download a MacOS version directly without the need to compile via Unity).[Shibbydex Haptics]For more information on scripts and currently compatible audio files, check out the Haptics Page here on the Shibbydex. You can also find information on the media file-format of an audio listed on it's File Page. In particular you can use the following search parameters linked here to find all mpeg formatted files on the Shibbydex. ShoutoutsI'd also like to shoutout some of my fellow content creators, and wonderful hypnotists alike, who are all helping explore haptics with their files as well.[MistressCalia.com][HypnoHellven.com] ♡[LambHypno.com][GiveInTo.Me][YallHypno.com]
